title: Ayurvedic Care+ Kumkumadi & Chandan Face Cream

details.description:
Rooted in Ayurvedic wisdom, this expert-formulated daily face cream blends 16 powerful natural ingredients, including Kesar, Chandan, Manjistha, and Lotus, to deliver a visibly clear, radiant, and naturally glowing complexion with every use.
Your Daily Dose of Ayurvedic Glow
Glow & Lovely Natural Face Cream Ayurvedic Care+ is not just a moisturiser, it is an expert Ayurvedic glow formula trusted by millions for its proven, natural approach to healthy, radiant skin.
Crafted with a precise blend of 16 Ayurvedic ingredients, this cream targets the three most common skin concerns together, marks, uneven skin tone, and dullness, delivering a visible, natural glow from the very first use, and transforming skin quality with continued, regular application.
Kesar (Saffron), Manjistha, and Lotus are known for their glow-enhancing and mark-clearing properties, visibly improving skin radiance over time. Lodhra, Khas, and Neelotpal soothe and calm stressed or sensitive skin, restoring comfort and balance with every application. Milk, Chandan (Sandalwood), and Wheatgerm Oil nourish the skin deeply, correcting uneven tone and leaving the complexion noticeably smoother and clearer.
This powerhouse of natural antioxidants and skin-glow actives goes beyond the surface, replenishing skin's vitality, softening texture, and building a lasting, healthy glow that no ordinary cream can deliver.
Dermatologically tested. Free from bleaching agents. Safe for daily use, twice a day, morning and night.
Suitable for all skin types. Apply on clean skin by dotting the cream over face and neck, then massaging gently in circular upward strokes until fully absorbed.
For amplified results, pair with Glow & Lovely Ayurvedic Care+ Facewash as Step 1 of your daily Ayurvedic glow routine. Best results with regular use.
